title: Not as easy as it looks...
text: Not as easy as it looks.... The video made this process look so simple.  This is the first cappuccino machine I have worked with, and I’m not finding this quite that simple.  Several less than acceptable results.  I hoped this would use pods, but it uses ground coffee.  I think some practice would help before I invite a crowd!  The instruction manual is not that easy for a beginner to follow, so that may be my problem.  I can’t produce anything that looks like a Starbucks cappuccino.  It may be my inexperience - so I split the stars - 2.5 for being difficult for a newbie...
